#!/usr/bin/env bash
# .git/hooks/pre-commit
set -e

MAX_KB={{max_kb}}
for f in $(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=AM); do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  size=$(wc -c < "$f")
  if [ "$size" -gt $((MAX_KB * 1024)) ]; then
    echo "reject: $f exceeds ${MAX_KB}KB"; exit 1
  fi
done

command -v ruff >/dev/null && ruff check . || true
command -v prettier >/dev/null && prettier --check . || true
summary_zh: pre-commit hook 擋大檔並跑 lint
